div.div: Skedda's public API (v1, read-only Beta, OpenAPI 3.1.1) exposes three resources: Assets, Booking Occurrences and Venue Users. Desks, rooms and parking are not separate kinds, but bookable/assigned/addOn categories carrying a venue-defined Type. Floors, buildings, maps, neighbourhoods and rules are not exposed.

switch.text: Skedda's public API (v1, read-only Beta, OpenAPI 3.1.1) exposes three resources: Assets, Booking Occurrences and Venue Users. Desks, rooms and parking are not separate kinds, but bookable/assigned/addOn categories carrying a venue-defined Type. Floors, buildings, maps, neighbourhoods and rules are not exposed.
